
## Installation

Download the `.dmg`, open it, and drag Prose to Applications. The app is signed
and notarized — no security bypass needed.

(The Mac App Store build ships separately, on its own review cadence.)

### Auto-Update

Existing users are prompted to update automatically.

## Requirements

- macOS (Apple Silicon)
- Anthropic API key for AI features ([get one](https://console.anthropic.com/))
